comment: The FADE CV sumRange is a time in seconds, not a voltage. What the module does depends on which jacks have cables in them: with the IN jack empty and one or both outputs patched, the outputs carry a 10V gate faded by the FADE knob instead of a routed signal. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
